reading.body:
Xiaomi has a foundation model, MiMo, placing it among Chinese companies building at the base layer of AI rather than only applying models others have trained.

The product record is sparse. It lists a single entry under Chinese Foundation Models, flags that cross-border data review is advised, and points to Xiaomi's consumer website rather than a dedicated research or developer portal. No compute figures, no parameter counts, no datacenter or power infrastructure details are attached to this record.

What the data does not cover is the part that matters most for understanding scale: how MiMo is trained, on what hardware, and where that hardware sits. The cross-border data note signals regulatory friction for anyone considering using or evaluating the model outside China, but it says nothing about the underlying resource footprint. The record establishes that Xiaomi is a participant in foundation model development, and stops there.
